_comment: Price table for the substrate savings meter (billing instrument). Founder-controlled -- edit this file, never a constant in code. Every rate must carry source_url and verified_on. See LianaBanyanPlatform/BISHOP_DROPZONE/SPEC_THE_COUPON_CLIPPER_PRICE_AWARE_ROUTING_AND_SAVINGS_METER_BP143.md Part One, and the licensing paper 'Help Them Help Us Help Ourselves' (J. Jones / FounderDenken) that this instrument exists to make auditable.

counterfactual_tokens_per_char.basis: 4 characters per token, a commonly cited rough heuristic for English text. This is a DISCLOSED APPROXIMATION used only to size a hypothetical flagship call from a REAL served answer's character length -- it never substitutes for a real provider-reported token count on the actual-cost side of a receipt. Any record using this path sets counterfactual_tokens_estimated=true so it is never confused with a measured count.
